base="https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases"
for p in \
 "io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.root-project.gradle.plugin/maven-metadata.xml" \
 "io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.root-project.gradle.plugin/1.0.56/io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.root-project.gradle.plugin-1.0.56.pom" \
 "io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/root-project.gradle.plugin/maven-metadata.xml" ; do
 code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 "$base/$p"); echo "$code  $p"; done
